blurb: The Edge Paintball Adventures offers paintball sessions on 10 playing fields over 50 acres. They provide group outings including corporate team building, birthday parties, and large group events. Sessions focus on teamwork, strategy, and fun in a safe environment.
extraNote: Must have a reservation with a paid deposit for group rates to be applied · No outside paintballs allowed · Players caught cheating will be asked to leave · Corner of K-96 and Ridge Road in Wichita · March through November
